description: Replace Budget category and yearly expense SUMIFS with named functions that filter detail rows by year and category without A1 references.

BUDGET_CATEGORY_SUM.definition:
=LET(
  years, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "_year"),
  categories, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "_category"),
  lines, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "budget line"),
  matching_rows, IFNA(
    FILTER(
      SEQUENCE(ROWS(years), 1, 2),
      years = BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
      categories = BUDGET_VALUE("_category"),
      lines <> ""
    ),
    0
  ),
  IF(
    INDEX(matching_rows, 1) = 0,
    0,
    SUM(MAP(matching_rows, LAMBDA(row_index,
      VALUE_BY_INDEX(S_BUDGET, row_index, column_name)
    )))
  )
)

BUDGET_YEAR_SUM.definition:
=LET(
  years, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "_year"),

  matching_rows, IFNA(
    FILTER(
      SEQUENCE(ROWS(years), 1, 2),
      years = BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
      categories <> "",
      lines <> ""
    ),
    0
  ),
  IF(
    INDEX(matching_rows, 1) = 0,
    0,
    SUM(MAP(matching_rows, LAMBDA(row_index,
      VALUE_BY_INDEX(S_BUDGET, row_index, column_name)
    )))
  )
)

BUDGET_YEAR_CONTINGENCY.definition:
=LET(
  years, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "_year"),
  categories, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "category"),
  lines, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "budget line"),
  matching_rows, IFNA(
    FILTER(
      SEQUENCE(ROWS(years), 1, 2),
      years = BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
      categories <> "",
      lines = ""
    ),
    0
  ),
  IF(
    INDEX(matching_rows, 1) = 0,
    0,
    SUM(MAP(matching_rows, LAMBDA(row_index,
      VALUE_BY_INDEX(S_BUDGET, row_index, "contingency")
    )))
  )
)
